name: Grade 9 Mathematics: Algebraic Expressions
subject: Mathematics
learningObjectives: By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to simplify algebraic expressions by collecting like terms
By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to expand simple brackets
learningActivities: Revision: learners identify like and unlike terms
Guided practice: learners expand brackets like 3(x + 2)
Independent work: learners solve algebraic problems
keyPoints: Like terms have the same letters and powers
Only like terms can be added or subtracted
commonMisconceptions: Forgetting to multiply every term inside the bracket
lessonEvaluation: Learners simplify five expressions and expand five brackets. Teacher marks and gives feedback.
teacherReflection: Most learners collected like terms correctly. Focus on bracket expansion next lesson.
